manifest.description: Diagnose whether a Java class's actual behavior matches its declared role, annotations, package, interfaces, and docs.
when_to_use: a service, view, controller, repository, adapter, or session class appears to own responsibilities outside its declared role
imports and metrics are legal but the operator needs semantic judgment about what the class really does
preparing a correction plan that may extract foreign behavior clusters from one Java class
anti_patterns: do not use for layer violations a static rule can prove
do not use for local cleanup that does not change ownership or boundaries
do not use on non-Java targets
